# The Institutional Will — complete editable platform copy

## 1. LONG VIDEO
Place founder wishes beside the separate records that could authorize—or fail to authorize—each outcome.

## 2. SHORT 01
“A manifesto is not necessarily a will, assignment, board resolution, or archive agreement.”

## 3. SHORT 02
“You cannot bequeath what you do not own.”

## 4. CAROUSEL
Intent; asset; owner; instrument; steward; alternate; access; funding; rehearsal; counsel.

## 5. AUDIO
A guided founder narration designed as a counsel-preparation record, not a legal instrument.

## 6. BEEHIIV / LINKEDIN / INSTAGRAM / PINTEREST
Keep the public edition educational; place personal decisions in private, professionally reviewed records.

## Claim ledger
- **VERIFIED:** U.S. copyright interests may transfer by will or intestacy, but coordinated succession can require multiple instruments. (S63, S64)
- **PROPOSAL:** A founder intent document is not represented as a legally operative estate, corporate, IP, or tax instrument. (S49, S52, S63)

## Publication discipline
Use the copy as written with the package's rendered social artwork. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, evidence labels, labor and jurisdiction limits, participant correction, and counsel or specialist boundaries.
